name: Geordie Shore
description: Geordie Shore is a British reality television series broadcast on MTV. Based in Newcastle upon Tyne, it premiered on 24 May 2011, and is the British spin-off of the American show Jersey Shore. "Geordie" is the regional nickname and dialect given to the people of the Tyneside area of North East England, and is closely associated with the city of Newcastle upon Tyne and its environs where the show is set. However the show includes cast members from various parts of North East England.

videos.title: Magaluf Madness (1)
videos.overview: The Geordie Shore cast head to Magaluf for the summer hols. The lads quickly make up for lost time with the ladies, and tensions explode with Char and Gaz, resulting in the biggest Geordie bust-up yet!

videos.title: Magaluf Madness (2)
videos.overview: There's more Magaluf madness as the Geordie Shore gang struggle to get along. Under the watchful eye of Charlotte and Vicky, Gary continues to charm the ladies and Holly rocks another wet t-shirt contest!

videos.title: On Tour with Geordie Shore
videos.overview: Sophie and James' wild adventures as they tour "Down Under"

videos.title: The Geordie Shore Awards
videos.overview: We Belive our Geordies have gone above and beyond by tashing on and getting mortal, so its time we reward them for services to fake tan and flirting.

videos.title: Chaos in Cancun Top Ten
videos.overview: The Geordie folks certainly let loose in Cancun, now you get to relive this in the Top 10 chaotic moments!

videos.title: Online Award
videos.overview: The MTV GMA 'Digital Darling' Award sets for recognise the most viewed Geordie Clips on MTV.co.uk. Expect lots of fighting, getting freaky and your favourite Geordie banter.

videos.title: Ten Years on The Toon Pt1
videos.overview: To celebrate ten years of Geordie Shore, Charlotte takes Nathan and James on a ride around Newcastle. They visit their old haunts whilst reminiscing about the time of their lives

videos.title: Ten Years on The Toon Pt2
videos.overview: To celebrate ten years of Geordie Shore, Charlotte takes Nathan and James on a ride around Newcastle. They visit their old haunts whilst reminiscing about the time of their lives

videos.title: Warm Welcome Home
videos.overview: It all kicks off when eight Geordies become housemates. Vicky can't decide if she prefers Jay or Greg, Charlotte tries her hardest to avoid Gaz's advances, Greg wants to leave and Holly, the only housemate in a relationship, is unfaithful within a few hours. But that, she'd argue, depends on your definition of the term unfaithful...

videos.title: A Romantic Meal
videos.overview: With Greg back on side, the Geordie Shore housemates are finally getting on... but how long can it last? Jay's aware that he's bitten off more than he can chew with Vicky, Holly tests her relationship boundaries even further, Charlotte fights off the continuing advances of Gaz, and Sophie gets the shock of her life when her parents turn up unannounced. All before last night's special friend has had time to leave...

videos.title: Hello Holly's Boyfriend
videos.overview: It's Jay's birthday in Geordie Shore: Vicky plays the dutiful "girlfriend", Holly's boyfriend Dan makes a surprise visit and Charlotte loses her battle to fight off Gaz. But eight become seven as the house is rocked by a shock departure.

videos.title: Where Is Holly?
videos.overview: When everyone realises that Holly's gone, the atmosphere in the house takes a turn for the worse. Vicky and Jay fall out as the "no tashing elsewhere" rule fails and Charlotte gives Gaz all the ammo he needs to play away from home. But how long can they all live apart? Especially when one more tries to leave Geordie Shore...

videos.title: Vicky's Not Happy
videos.overview: There is a shock for the cast as Holly makes a surprise return to the Geordie Shore house, but not before Jay and Gaz face their toughest work assignment at a working man's club. Anna pushes Vicky too far with some salsa dancing and Holly's happiness is short lived as a late night phone call ends in heartbreak.

videos.title: It's Getting Complicated Vicky
videos.overview: It's the final episode of Geordie Shore but there is certainly no fairy tale ending. Can Holly and her boyfriend Dan's 10 month relationship survive an altercation in the car park of an out of town shopping centre, Gaz gives Charlotte some serious news but is it what she was hoping for and for Jay and Vicky their relationship erupts in the most shocking way imaginable.

videos.title: The Reunion
videos.overview: The Geordie Shore cast are reunited along with friends, family, fans, and a few surprises to unravel the truths of those involved and hear the opinions of those who loved and loathed the show.

videos.title: New Additions
videos.overview: They may be back in Newcastle, but it's all change for Geordie Shore; Greg has left to find true love, Vicky and Sophie have pledged chastity to their new boyfriends, Gary promises Charlotte's Mum that he won't, Charlotte promises to do the ironing for a year if she does and James is nurturing a worldie-magnet comb-over. But with two new housemates ready to join the family, peace isn't set to last.

videos.title: You Can't Help Your Feelings
videos.overview: Vicky and Ricci fall for each other, James struggles to neck on and Jay and Gary fight over Rebecca. But that's nothing when the house is rocked as Gary's nocturnal habits push Charlotte over the edge.

videos.title: James Needs To Score
videos.overview: There's no time for the house to mourn Charlotte's departure as Vicky and Ricci's nocturnal spooning is interrupted by an unexpected visitor. Rebecca and Jay are still flirting outrageously whilst Gary and James are quick to get their kit off. Sophie has her heart broken and Holly is left reeling as James has the night of his life.

videos.title: We Miss You Charlotte
videos.overview: James continues his lucky streak with the ladies unlike unlucky in love Sophie who is played for a mug. Gary persuades Charlotte to return... but has she managed to get over him as she hoped? Rebecca lays her cards on the table with Jay, and Ricci and Vicky take things to the next level. After a big night out, Holly finally summons the courage to make a play for her man - but does she get what she wants?

videos.title: The Party Is Ruined
videos.overview: Tears consume Sophie after a surprise visit from her very own six-packed Adonis, but Charlotte and Vicky aren't going to let her steal the limelight and swiftly join her in heartbreak. The 'cheer us all up', party ends in carnage as Charlotte tries to move on, Vicky cements her future and the boys exchange blows.

videos.title: The Girls Go To Far
videos.overview: Disastrous consequences for Ricci and Gary rock the Geordie Shore house leaving Vicky and Charlotte stunned. Picking up the pieces, Sophie has a difficult decision to make whilst Charlotte learns Gaz's true feelings for her. With Jay and James about to have the night of their lives, the girls set off on a road trip tackling a colonic, Geordie Style, with it all ending in tears before bedtime. But Jay and James have other plans for bedtime.

videos.title: The Truth Is Revealed
videos.overview: The honeymoon period is over as Vicky and Ricci split. Rebecca reveals her secret party trick, much to Jay's delight whilst Gary comes clean with Charlotte. Holly's Mum and Gaz' Dad make an appearance and the whole house falls out when the girl's jealous rage causes the boys to react. The house is at war once more.

videos.title: We Are Family After All
videos.overview: With only days to go until the end of the present series, hardly any relationships are left intact. Vicky and Ricci doggedly move on, Sophie gets dumped and Jay leaves an unpleasant taste in Rebeccas mouth. But its not long before most of them have made up as only they know how.

videos.title: The Reunion
videos.overview: The reunion brings the cast and their friends and families together to find out what really went down during series two. Host Russell Kane will rummage through the tensions, passions, laughter and tears.

videos.title: Best Bits
videos.overview: Ten of the most crazy, mental and altogether 'shockin' Geordie Shore moments from the past season. Believe us when we say there are loads to choose from.

videos.title: The Geordies Hit Cancun
videos.overview: It's time to swap the grey river Tyne for the crystal blue waters of Cancun, Mexico for the carnage of Spring break. Vicky and Ricci are loved up, Jay is missing the love of his life, Chloe and with Charlotte vowing to go nowhere near the parsnip and James refusing a repeat performance with Holly this is going to be one vacation they'll never forget.

videos.title: James' Drought
videos.overview: With the house reduced to carnage and Sophie losing even more faith in back-at-home boyfriend Joel, there are still plenty of beaches to party on. Holly ups her game in the pursuit of James and shows that she can take rejection very badly. Charlotte and Gaz come to a major decision, and for Vicky and Ricci, the perfect relationship bubble, explodes. It all ends in tears.

videos.title: Nurse Holly
videos.overview: Sophie is elated as Joel surprises her with a visit. But will he be able to behave himself in paradise? The boys try out Mexican Wrestling but it all ends very badly for James who leaves in an ambulance. And with everyone fearing that his worldie mission may now be over, Holly moves in on her incapacitated prey.

videos.title: Vicky And Holly's Task
videos.overview: The chaos in Cancun continues as Gaz celebrates his birthday in true Geordie style with Charlotte taking her holiday romance to the next level and Volcano Vicky erupting as Cancun Chris gets sweet revenge sending her and Holly on a road trip from hell.

videos.title: The Tequila Trip
videos.overview: Vicky and Ricci return to the house in time for Becca's birthday, which goes off in usual Geordie style. Cancun Chris penalises everyone for drinking his Tequila and Gary and Charlotte are sent off into deepest darkest Mexico to replace his valued drink. But with scorpions galore, will it turn out to be the sexy time Charlotte wants?

videos.title: The Argument
videos.overview: Gary, jumps into yet another threesome and an unexpected phone call means James has to choose between his best mates and Holly.... For Charlotte, a night out trying to forget about Gary ends with disastrous results. The housemates are devastated as Sophie reveals that she wants to leave Mexico to return to boyfriend Joel in the UK.

videos.title: Vicky's Having Doubts
videos.overview: The boy, girl divide returns once more: Charlotte and Gaz aren't speaking, Becca and Jay are continually arguing and Holly and James' nurse patient relationship is back to a strictly professional level. But will Gaz's plans to cleanse the bad energy in the house really sort matters out? Meanwhile, Ricci and Gaz go shopping for an engagement ring for Vicky as the house finds out his plans.

videos.title: The Big Question
videos.overview: It's the final few days of Spring Break and the house is rocked by the loss of yet another member. In the last hours, to the disbelief of everyone, Ricci plans his proposal to Vicky, James and nurse Holly try out the suspension on the wheelchair and Charlotte clambers into bed with Gary. Down to the final five, Cancun has changed the Geordie Shore house forever.

videos.title: Gary Meets His Match
videos.overview: After a fun filled summer in Cancun the Geordie Shore gang are back in their playground and they are back with a bang. With two new spaces in the house it can only mean one thing, fresh meet for the family . They are all back for more obscene nights out as they are ready to take Newcastle by storm.

videos.title: The Engagement Party
videos.overview: It's time to get mortal as the Geordie Shore gang throw Ricci & Vicki an engagement party to remember. There'll be booze, banter & bucking aplenty as the Geordies party like only they know how, but when Charlotte decides it's the perfect opportunity to introduce her new boyfriend to the family, it turns into a night that everyone will remember for all the wrong reasons.

videos.title: Holly's First Date
videos.overview: With Ricci & Sophie having been asked to leave the house, the rest of the Geordie Shore gang decide a road trip to Liverpool is in order to check out the clubs and talent, but when James reveals a secret he's been keeping from the house and mortal Charlotte climbs into Gary's bed, it seems like everything is heading further south than they'd planned.

videos.title: Just Apologise Sophie
videos.overview: The Geordie Shore house is a far from happy place with Vicky & Sophie still not talking and the rest of the house caught in the divide and whilst James can't wait to bring new girlfriend Kate into the family, its stormy seas ahead at the Shore when Charlotte confesses to her boyfriend about her late night visit to Gary's bed.

videos.title: It's All About The B's
videos.overview: Peace has finally been restored in the Geordie Shore house now that Vicky and Sophie have made up but, nothing lasts forever and when Ricci's green eyed monster sees red on a family night out, its disaster, not love, that's in the air.

videos.title: Hello Dublin
videos.overview: It's James' birthday and the Geordie Shore gang plan a surprise trip to Dublin to celebrate with an extra special secret guest, but on their return their Irish high is quickly brought down by Ricci's return with some devastating news.

videos.title: The Girls Try Comedy
videos.overview: With Ricci gone from the Geordie Shore house, the rest of the gang are determined to keep Vicky's spirits up and the boys decide that what better way than a walk on the wild side and camping, but while the boys mock the girls in their far from natural habitat, they aren't laughing for long as on their return to civilisation, they find themselves at the mercy of a wild pack of women.

videos.title: An Emotional Ending
videos.overview: It's all coming to an end in the Geordie Shore house with some keener to leave than others, but before they pack their bags, there's still time for a big blow out bash Geordie style and it seems like love is all around as those warm and fuzzy familiar feelings resurface once again.

videos.title: Amsterdam Welcomes The Geordies
videos.overview: The Geordie Shore gang are back in a pimped-up pad and ready to cause chaos once again. Its boys against girls as Charlotte and Holly form an alliance to take on the Buck Squad, while Boss Anna has a surprise in store for the family as she sends them on a European adventure that some of them may want to forget.

videos.title: You Will Get Punished Dan
videos.overview: The gang return from Amsterdam and it's time to tear Newcastle a new one. Vicky and Ricci celebrate breaking the Geordie Shore relationship curse at their one year anniversary dinner, but it's not all smiles as Holly and James still can't stand the sight of one another.

videos.title: Here's How To Be A Lady
videos.overview: There's tension in the Toon, as James brings girlfriend Kate on a night out with the gang, leaving Holly unimpressed. The Geordie Shore house explodes as Vicky and Ricci have a row to remember, Scott flips out, and Holly has to find a novel way to calm him down. And with all the chaos going on around them, Gary and Charlotte seem to think they're back in Amsterdam...

videos.title: Let's Take Over Prague
videos.overview: The gang are back on their Geordie Tour of Europe, and this time they're off to Prague for banter, birds, and booze galore. Chaos reigns as Gaz gets mortal and kicks off at Charlotte while booze also gets the better of Dan, who upsets Vicky and Ricci in the process. And as the boys get stuck into the local strip clubs, it's the girls getting their guns out for a change at the shooting range.

videos.title: Old Habits Return
videos.overview: The chaos continues as the gang return from Prague to a turbulent Toon. Holly and Kate come face to face on a night out, while Dan comes face to face with a ham sandwich and gets in a pickle with Scott. And the house is in total meltdown as Charlotte and Gary finally come to blows over their on/off relationship, and it looks like it could be the end for Vicky and Ricci.

videos.title: The Boys Get Their International Wings
videos.overview: Charlotte returns to the Geordie Shore house just in time to join the rest of the gang on a Geordie Tour of Barcelona. There's booze and banter aplenty as Dan leads the lads on a night out, and with Ricci out of the picture, single Vicky leads a stag do on a sightseeing tour. And as our favourite Geordies bathe in the Spanish sun, sea, sex and sangria - Charlotte has a bombshell to drop on Gary...

videos.title: House Party Disaster
videos.overview: The gang return from Barcelona with Charlotte's declaration of love for Gary still hanging in the air and Vicky set for a final showdown with Ricci. While James organises a day at a military boot camp, the girls decide to throw an American-themed house party, but it's anything but united as Charlotte gets into a state over Gary resulting in the biggest fight in Geordie Shore history...

videos.title: Apres-Ski
videos.overview: Will the gang cool off after the biggest fight in Geordie Shore history, Charlotte finds herself in hot water with boss Anna, and there's a distinctly icy atmosphere between the boys and the girls as they all head off to the French Alps for their final Geordie Tour of the series.

videos.title: Best of Geordie Tours
videos.overview: A look back at the latest series of Geordie Shore with your favorite dysfunctional family. The gang also reveal what it was like to go through all the boozing and banter from their turbulant European tour.

videos.title: The Gang Go Down Under
videos.overview: They're back and this time the Geordies are heading down under and deep into the Bush! Sydney may be over 10,000 miles from Newcastle but nothing is going to stop the tashin' and partying and everything in between. Holly and James still haven't put their differences behind them and are a war zone waiting to happen, Gary and Scott are on a mission to pull every girl in Sydney, Vicky is newly single and is looking to leave Ricci firmly in the past, and Sophie's stuck in the middle as Charlotte's nowhere to be seen! Just another day for Geordie Shore!

videos.title: Family Means Family
videos.overview: The group are in high spirits as a surprise visit from Jay means a few days of non-stop partying. Charlotte is still coming to terms with her feelings for Gaz, Vicky starts dating whilst James’ battle with Holly is set to continue. The competition for the title of ‘top shagger’ shows no sign of letting up as every girl in Sydney is on Scotty and Gaz’s radar and it looks like Gaz may have taken pulling to a whole new level!

videos.title: House Divides
videos.overview: James and Gaz come to blows and the following explosive argument sees Gaz forced to leave the house. But is being banished such a bad thing? Gaz and Scotty avoid the punishment handed out to James and discover what’s really in the Australian bush. With the house to themselves Charlotte struggles, Sophie provides an intriguing revelation, Vicky tashes on and Holly gets up close and personal with the one and only Scotty T.

videos.title: Vicky Meets Dan
videos.overview: Whilst the fittest guy in Australia sends the girls into a spin, Scotty and Gaz square up as nightclubbing gets nasty. House destruction sees Gary head into the bush, Charlotte have an epiphany, Vicky swoons and Scotty T enjoy his punishment just a little too much.

videos.title: Anger Management
videos.overview: Charlotte returns from the Bush a new woman. The housemates lay down the law for Scotty; slapping him with a drinking ban in the hope that he will stop smashing up the house. But with an upcoming house party and his birthday to celebrate, can he hold it together? Meanwhile, Fit Dan turns up to the house party and Vicky is not going to waste this opportunity. Holly gets cock fright, Sophie's perfect relationship reveals a crack and Charlotte and Gary experience the ultimate test.

videos.title: The Haunted House
videos.overview: The Geordie Shore house is descending into chaos causing Sheep Steve to take drastic action. Charlotte turns psycho and wrecks the house whilst Holly strongly voices her opinion on Scotty T's latest conquest as the girls turn on him. With Sheep Steve having three housemates removed from the house, Scotty and Holly get much closer than Scotty thought they would as they head deep into the bush… And this time it's Vicky who gets it in the neck for her naughty behavior.

videos.title: The Pie Shop Argument
videos.overview: James and Gary come to blows, sending shockwaves through the house. Charlotte's heart strings are pulled as she offers Gary support. A secret singles trip to the Whitsundays ends in disaster for the boys.

videos.title: Goodbye Australia
videos.overview: As their time in Sydney comes to an end, the singles make it their mission to have a wild night out in the Whitsundays. Vicky and Fit Dan have a never ending date, Scotty sets out to find some company and an indiscretion from Gary sees him joining James in the Prison Hotel. And will Charlotte get closure once and for all?

videos.title: The Bucket List
videos.overview: Buzzing! The Geordies are back where they belong, in Newcastle, for a jaw-dropping summer season of partying, pulling, bucking, necking on and getting mortal. But just as they're settling back in to the house, there's a shock as stunning new girl Marnie arrives, determined to have fun, flirt with the boys and not care what the others think. She's Sophie's little cousin, but Charlotte, Holly and Vicky find it hard to welcome Marnie as she starts to break girl-codes and house rules. James keeps his distance while Scott and Gary need to decide if it's worth going there with their hot new housemate Marnie.

videos.title: Double Dating
videos.overview: The Geordies are back partying, pulling and tashing on in Newcastle, but they're still reeling from the explosive fallout following new girl Marnie's arrival. She's Sophie's little cousin, she doesn't care what anyone thinks, and she can't keep her hands off Scott. A big night out getting mortal brings the dream team of Gary and Scott back together, necking on and bucking as only they can, but it ends with Scott completely losing his cool and trying to smash the house up. Meanwhile Charlotte is devastated, cracking under the pressure of having a boyfriend in London while trying to party in the Toon with her Geordie mates. Vicky tries to help Holly get over her cock fright with a girls night out to see some male strippers, but there's more drama as Sophie tries to stop cousin Marnie upsetting the other girls.

videos.title: Holly's Birthday
videos.overview: Buzzin'! It's Holly's 21st birthday, and the Geordies celebrate as only they know how - with a mint house party, getting mortal, and tashing on. Can Holly overcome her cock fright and get a birthday buck? Will James risk Holly's fury by bringing his girlfriend Kate to the party? How many girls can Gary bed at once? And why is Charlotte weeing in the boys' bin? Marnie necks on with a handsome partygoer, only to find out that it was one of Scott's best mates, and when Scott finds out, he goes on the rampage. Will things between Scott and Marnie ever recover? Meanwhile there's a tiny tragedy in the house, leading to an unexpected funeral on the beach.

videos.title: It All Kicks Off
videos.overview: The Geordie Shore house is rocked to the core as Charlotte and Holly have an explosive falling out with new girl Marnie in a nightclub argument that gets way out of hand. There's more drama as Scott and Gary's friendship is pushed to the absolute limit when Scott discovers that Gary has taken flirting with Marnie to the next level. Jay makes a morale-boosting return, but can even the daddy of the group bring the house back together?

videos.title: First Impressions Stick
videos.overview: There's an explosive situation to deal with as Marnie returns to the house following her nightclub fall-out with Holly and Charlotte. The girls can't deal with Marnie coming back, and the boys are left in shock as a fierce slanging match erupts. Is there any hope that the girls will ever make up? The Geordies head to London to get mortal in the capital, and everyone's wondering if Charlotte's London-based boyfriend Mitch will make a surprise appearance on their big night out. But the partying is destined to end in tears for Charlotte, as events take an unexpected turn and Charlotte and Holly's friendship is left hanging by a thread.

videos.title: So Much For Family Night
videos.overview: The Geordies' raucous summer comes to a climax, with more getting mortal and necking on, and a final piece of high drama which leaves the house in a state of shock.   Gary and Holly are still furious at the way Charlotte's boyfriend treated her during their night out in London. But Charlotte doesn't want to hear anyone talking bad about her boyfriend, and things soon come to a head in dramatic fashion.   For the last night, Marnie shaves her fairy for Scott, after she decides she's going to put out if he behaves himself. But will they finally get together.

videos.title: Gaz's Birthday
videos.overview: The Geordies are back and during their first night on the Toon getting mortal, Gaz arrives with a surprise: his name is Aaron, he's Gaz's mate, and he's the new lad in the Geordie Shore house. The house have a wild party to celebrate Gary's birthday with a good helping of tequila, mayhem and a couple of threesomes. Holly is missing Charlotte. She decides to get some animals in the house so that Charlotte will come back. So she gets some tortoises.

videos.title: Lad Code
videos.overview: Shirts are off and fists are about to fly after Gaz gets jealous when Marnie flirts with new boy Aaron. Everyone’s buzzin’ as Vicky returns to the house, and there’s the first ever Tash-On Tours as the Geordies put their own tequila-fuelled spin on singles nights.

videos.title: The Family's Reunited
videos.overview: Charlotte is back! And her arrival couldn’t have come at a worse time, as she walks in on a double date and finds out all about Gaz getting with Marnie. New lad Aaron wins a date with Holly after completing her challenge but he reveals that he’s actually got a thing for Vicky.

videos.title: Tash On Tours
videos.overview: With Charlotte back in the house, all eyes are on Gaz and Marnie and whether they’ll decide to continue sleeping together. Charlotte is in tears after Gaz and Aaron blame her for creating a boy-girl divide, and the crew take Tash-On Tours to Manchester to share the Geordie approach to singles nights, getting mortal and necking on!

videos.title: The New Boys
videos.overview: Things kick off in the house as Aaron hears Vicky and the girls slagging him off on the eve of his third date with Vicky. And while the lads are out at work the girls get a massive surprise as new boy Kyle arrives to join the family.

videos.title: A Trip To Iceland
videos.overview: As the lads and lasses wake up and reflect on Kyle’s sudden arrival last night, the girls are hoping he won’t be sucked into being Gaz’s lapdog and Vicky regrets her cheeky tash on with Kyle.

videos.title: Marnie Exposes Gary
videos.overview: The group wake up in Iceland with mixed feelings. The girls are angry with the lads for ‘pie-ing’ them last night and pulling girls. Kyle and Holly get very flirty on a trip to the ‘Penis Museum’ and the Geordie Tours next stop is to an impressive geyser (that “smells like one of James’ protein farts!”)

videos.title: Aye Do
videos.overview: Will Aaron and Marnie finally get together and will Gaz and Scott make up after Gaz broke his own Lad Code? Meanwhile Charlotte and Holly announce Geordie Shore’s first-ever wedding!

videos.title: The New Boss
videos.overview: There's a shock for the others when Vicky gets a promotion to team leader, or 'Boss Vicky' as she soon becomes known. She gets to choose who goes to work, but will she be able to keep everyone in check, and will she punish anyone who steps out of line?

videos.title: A Party Gone Wrong
videos.overview: Boss Vicky takes the team to run their first Gay 'Tash-on Tours' job, with great success. But everyone is concerned about Charlotte when she reveals she isn't happy and that all is not well in her relationship with Mitch.

videos.title: Bonjour Geordies
videos.overview: They all head off to France without Marnie who hasn't returned to the house after kissing Kyle at Holly's house party. Kyle is left to bear the brunt of the anger from the lads in Paris.

videos.title: Single Charlotte
videos.overview: Vicky is in trouble with Boss Anna after making a mess of the Tash on Tours job in Paris. As a punishment Anna asks Vicky to make 200 origami swans for a Japanese-themed event. It's up to Vicky to get everyone to work together to make them, but Marnie decides she can't be bothered and sets herself on a collision course with Vicky.

videos.title: Marnie & Scott's Mistake
videos.overview: Marnie and Vicky's reconciliation is short lived when Vicky discovers Marnie's been lying to her all along. A tash on tours night in Charlotte's home town of Sunderland ends in disaster when Aaron sees Marnie and Scott getting way too close for his liking.

videos.title: Gary And The Farm Girl
videos.overview: The Geordies are heading out of the Toon and into the country to host a Tash on Tours night at Lakefest in Gloucestershire. Charlotte and Gaz have their first real test when Charlotte spots Gaz flirting with a girl at the hoedown...will she be able to hold back from turning into 'Psycho Charlotte' and will Gaz be able to prove to her that he really has changed?

videos.title: Blue Skull Crew
videos.overview: The ‘boyfriend club’ is well and truly up and running with Charlotte, Holly and Marnie all waking up in the boys' bedroom. Vicky’s feeling left out and missing her boyfriend James so the gang arrange a surprise visit for her...but will this make Vicky feel happier in the house or remind her of what she’s missing even more?

videos.title: Christmas Comes Early
videos.overview: Tis’ the season to get Mortal! It’s Christmas time in the Geordie Shore house and like every other family Christmas it’s not without its festive finger-blasting, tantrums round the tree and mayhem under the mistletoe. It’s James' birthday and the last Geordie Shore house party and in true style they certainly go out with a ‘bang’!

videos.title: The Boys' Secret Pact
videos.overview: Buzzin'! Our favourite party animals are back! When Charlotte finds out about a pact between Gary and Aaron she hatches a plan - but will she end up with egg on her face? Meanwhile James is having doubts about his future in the house.

videos.title: The New Arrivals
videos.overview: It's all change in the house as James makes a shock announcement and two new housemates come through the door. But the newbies' first night out is ruined when a huge fight breaks out between Charlotte, Marnie and Holly.

videos.title: Gary's Big Reveal
videos.overview: It's the Newbies first morning in the house but with Holly, Kyle and Charlotte gone how will the family get back together? Holly opens her heart to Kyle but does he feel the same? And a shock revelation from Gary leaves Charlotte heartbroken.

videos.title: Charlotte's Broken Heart
videos.overview: It's the day that Charlotte's been dreading, Gary introdices his new girlfriend to the family but will Psycho Charlotte put in an appearance? Meanwhile Marnie and Aaron get very flirty!

videos.title: King Nathan
videos.overview: Anna tells the Geordies she's got a job for them in another country leaving them all buzzing! That is until they turn up to a caravan site in Wales where Marnie decides to give Aaron some home truths.

videos.title: Holly's Big Decision
videos.overview: Hamburg is about to feel the full force of Tash on Tours, but are they ready for Marnie kicking off at Aaron?

videos.title: Chloe's Big Meltdown
videos.overview: Newbie Chloe meets 'psycho Charlotte' after a night out goes sour, and Holly's return to the house is ruined when she's confronted with the true reason Kyle doesn't want to make their relationship official ... is it all over for them?!

videos.title: Making It Official
videos.overview: Scotty T is back to 'jump start' the final episode with a dare-devil activity for his Geordie crew. Meanwhile, tensions run high as Holly waits to hear Kyle's decision.

videos.title: Holly And Kyle's Bust Up

videos.title: The Answer to the Big Question
videos.overview: As the trip to the Algarve comes to an end. Louis action’s continue to cause drama amongst the Geordie’s and Holly finally gets some answers to the question everyone has been wondering!

videos.title: The Pitter Patter Of Wedding Bells!
videos.overview: Marnie and Casey welcome a new arrival to their family! Elswhere, another monumental day looms and the Geordies are in Ibiza gearing up for Hollys wedding day!

videos.title: Back On The Toon
videos.overview: The Geordies are back in Newcastle for a night on the Toon! Who will show up and after all the recent drama will it be a Night to remember for all the right or wrong reasons?

videos.title: The Reunion Finale
videos.overview: It's time for one final house party at the Geordie Shore House to bring the Reunion to a close. As the group prepare to say goodbye, will it all be on good terms or is there still issues from the past that need to be faced?

videos.title: The Geordie's Are Back!
videos.overview: Marnie Simpson is planning her dream wedding, whilst Charlotte Crosby, Holly Hagan, and Sophie Kasaei catch up on pregnancy, parenthood and new boyfriends.

videos.title: The Big Day!
videos.overview: Marnie Simpson and Casey Johnson tie the knot; however, not all is perfect about the day, as she, Nathan and Chloe reveal issues they have with fellow wedding guest Charlotte.

videos.title: Ground Rules
videos.overview: Charlotte and her boyfriend Jake are struggling with the mess and noise in the family villa, and when Marnie discovers Jake has been vocal about their son Rox, things take a nasty turn.

videos.title: Mams at War!
videos.overview: The Geordies head to the zoo for some family fun, but it ends in disaster. When the mess of the family villa becomes too much for some, an argument erupts that shakes the villa.

videos.title: Will She Stay or Will She Go?
videos.overview: The Geordies are left reeling by Charlotte and Jake's shock exit from the villa, with questions being asked whether they will return or have gone for good.

videos.title: Mam's to the Rescue
videos.overview: The Geordies finally find out whether Charlotte plans to return to the villa or leave for good. Meanwhile, Chloe reaches out to her ex Sam Gowland, seeking an apology and closure.

videos.title: A Case of the Ex
videos.overview: The Geordie's head out for their biggest night in Cyprus so far, but things quickly take a turn when Sophie's loyalties over the Charlotte and Marnie fallout come into question.

videos.title: Carnage and Closure!
videos.overview: After three years, Chloe and Sam Gowland come face-to-face for the first time since their break-up; Abbie's radge nanna and Chloe's mum arrive in Cyprus and are ready to cause some carnage of their own.

videos.title: Back to the Toon
videos.overview: The Geordie's are left speechless when James makes a shocking announcement; Charlotte and Nathan come face to face for the first time since Nathan aired his drunk opinions on Charlotte.

videos.title: New Beginnings
videos.overview: As Holly heads into hospital for her C-Section, the rest of the Geordie's are having one last night out on the toon for James's leaving party. However, it's unknown who will turn up.

videos.title: Geordie Shore, Thai-Aye!
videos.overview: Best man James and the Geordie lads hit Ko Samui for Kyle's Stag Do. Nathan and the girls have gone rogue in Bangkok. And Sophie's feeling out of sorts, has her fallout with Marnie caused it?

videos.title: Sun, Sea & Scotty-T!
videos.overview: Nathan and Chloe have a wild night out in Bangkok but agree it's time to head over to Ko Samui where Holly is on her own, surrounded by exes. The family are buzzing to be reunited but things get awkward for Ricci when Chantelle arrives at the villa.

videos.title: Trouble in Paradise!
videos.overview: Tensions rise when Kyle and James confront Jay and Ricci about not showing up to Kyle's engagement party. Things get awkward for Sophie when Marnie rocks up to the Stag Do!

videos.title: It's A Family Affair
videos.overview: Marnie and Sophie thrash out their problems and it gets tense. The villa welcomes some new arrivals, and Ricci can not believe that Chantelle's been saying whatever happened between them meant nothing.

videos.title: Full Moon Carnage
videos.overview: Ricci confronts Chantelle about saying their fling meant nothing. His good intentions also backfire when he tries to explain to James's Leah that Jay's tongue-in-cheek comments were harmless.

videos.title: A Decent Proposal
videos.overview: Boozy trash-talk leads to Chantelle and Abbie beefing and Nathan and Chloe having a big row, with Chloe leaving the villa! Amongst the chaos, James proposes to Leah. Will she say yes?

videos.title: Will She, Won't She?
videos.overview: Kyle announces a couples retreat to Ko Pha-Nang but after James's engagement, Sophie's questioning whether her relationship is heading in the right direction.

videos.title: Ko Samui Kick Off
videos.overview: Ricci tells Abbie he thinks Leah acted like a 'narcissist' during their recent row. Abbie takes offence to his choice of word and they fall out. But tensions really spill over when Jordan and Casey come face to face for the first time in months.

videos.title: What Did You Call Me?!
videos.overview: Just as it looks like things between Casey and Jordan are about to break down, a surprise apology saves the day. Abbie finally decides it's time to tell Leah about Ricci's controversial comment. Could this shatter the newfound harmony in the villa?

videos.title: Never say Never!
videos.overview: It's the Geordies' final day in the Thailand and there is still a divide to repair. It's up to Sophie and Marnie to fix the family after Chantelle and Abbie's argument. And a familiar face from the past makes a surprise appearance.

videos.title: Lisbon Baby
videos.overview: Nathan steps up to organize Chloe's 30th birthday celebrations in Lisbon, but will Aaron convince Gary to join the crew for the first time in years, and can the Geordie family survive the divide caused by ongoing beef between Ricci and James?

videos.title: Geordie Tour Why Aye
videos.overview: It's an OG reunion for Chloe's 30th as one by one Aaron arrives, then Kyle, then Jay! Aaron convinces Gary to come back now that the radgies have mellowed, but as friends reunite and Ricci gathers allies, will Kyle feel James' absence more than ever?

videos.title: Did Someone Order Gary Beadle?
videos.overview: Ricci pulls Kyle for a chat to discuss the simmering tension and Sophie and Jordan arrive at the villa and inject some positive energy into the crew. Meanwhile, Gary leaves the UK and heads to Lisbon, to join in with the celebrations.

videos.title: Beadle's Back!
videos.overview: After almost a decade, Gary Beadle is reunited with his Geordie Shore family. It's a heartwarming coming together and the crew head straight out to the local marina, to enjoy a boat party to celebrate his arrival.

videos.title: Chloe's Dirty-Thirtieth!
videos.overview: Chloe a Thirtieth birthday party to remember! But tensions rise when James and Leah arrive to join in the celebrations. Ricci and Jay finally get to have their say, and James and Leah don't pull any punches either.

videos.title: Spill The Tea!
videos.overview: Kyle's Vicky flies to Lisbon but there's just one problem; Kyle's got no idea where she's going to sleep! Nathan can't stop thinking about the rumor that James has bad mouthed him behind his back so he decides to confront him.

videos.title: Back To Nature!
videos.overview: Nathan asks James outright if he's been saying things behind his back and things get tense. The family get nostalgic and reflect on their time on the show, which makes Jay realise he needs to do more to heal the divide within the group.

videos.title: Gary...The Second Coming!
videos.overview: Kyle and Jay insist that Ricci and James talk through their differences. It's a positive chat and they agree to be civil for the sake of the family. Leah pulls Ricci for a chat too, but despite her good intentions, it all goes west!

videos.title: Peace At Last!
videos.overview: After a bumpy ride, Leah and Ricci finally sort things out. The Geordies decide to hit the Club and although it's something they rarely do anymore, it brings back memories, and the good times roll on their last night in Lisbon.

videos.title: Births, Brides and Bye-byes!
videos.overview: Marnie and Casey welcome their new baby daughter, Kixee, into the world and introduce her to her big brothers. Kyle and Vicky head off to Rome for their dream wedding, where their guests are blown away by the splendor and emotion of the day.
